_comment: Verification fixtures. Supplied directly to the verifier by the experiment runner; never passed to a repair agent. expected_result is declared by the fixture author, independently of any agent output.

scenarios.description: Same failure mechanism, different inputs: batch job already ready at the first check.
Interactive job ready at the second check. The baseline completes it.
Interactive job that needs four polls while running. The baseline waits correctly and completes it.
Batch job that stays running for three polls. Detects premature fetch_result calls.
